arrivalDate.description: New arrival date; omitted keeps the current date.

departureDate.description: New departure date; omitted keeps the current date.

roomTypeId.description: New room type; omitted keeps the current type.

guestId.description: Logical reference to the guests schema.

guest.description: New guest link; omitted keeps the current guest.

sellableUnits.description: Optional and advisory (ADR-0006): ignored for the repriced change; the server derives the ceiling from the room inventory Rooms records for the effective type and dates. A malformed value is still VALIDATION_FAILED.

priceBasis.description: Advisory (ADR-0007): the server re-derives the frozen total and the applied discount name from Rates QuotePrice for the effective (post-change) room type, dates, and discount. The asserted totalMinor never sets a stored value; a value that disagrees with the quote is refused PRICE_CHANGED (409). The field stays required for the deprecation window. An omitted or null discountName means the new quote carries no discount: the price basis asserts the whole new quote.

totalMinor.description: The recalculated total the caller shows; compared with the Rates quote, never stored (ADR-0007 D3).

discountName.description: Discount to quote with; omitted or null means no discount, and the stored name is the one the quote applied (ADR-0007 D2).

errors.when: No sellable unit left for the new type and dates; details name type+dates (NFR-CON-1).

The room inventory could not be read, so the change was refused; details name upstream rooms and CheckRoomTypeSellability (ADR-0006 D4). The price could not be read either, so the change is refused rather than stored at an unverified total; details name upstream rates and QuotePrice (ADR-0007 D4).

The body's priceBasis.totalMinor differs from the Rates QuotePrice total for the effective room type, dates, and discount, so nothing was changed; details name roomTypeId, arrivalDate, departureDate, requestedTotalMinor, and quotedTotalMinor (ADR-0007 D3).
The reservation already left the confirmed state, or a stay restriction is violated for the new dates.

Missing field, bad date order, missing repriced total, or a hotel-mandatory guest field is missing; the Rates quote may also refuse an unknown discount naming discountName or an ambiguous plan set naming ratePlanName, surfaced unchanged (ADR-0007 D4).

Unknown reservation reference, or an unknown new room type refused by Rooms and surfaced unchanged (ADR-0006 D4). Rates may also answer no_rate_price or no_rate_plan and that refusal is surfaced unchanged too, changing nothing (ADR-0007 D4).
